name: turn-review
description: After a turn ends, a utility model picks the tool calls later turns no longer need: dead-end calls are dropped, long results are cut down to the lines that mattered. Reference example for Stop hooks.

config.description: A turn whose tool calls and results add up to fewer estimated tokens than this is left alone, without asking the model.
A turn larger than this many estimated tokens is not reviewed (it would not fit the reviewer comfortably); ordinary compaction deals with it.
